lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, extending from the branchial region posteriorly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a grid-like configuration of nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small dark focal mark or lesion is present on a vertical ridge posterior to the gills, specifically indicated by an overlaid black arrow.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a graphical black arrow artifact pointing to the mid-lateral flank region.
